note: Market evidence for L9, researched 2026-10-28 by a research agent with WebSearch/WebFetch; primary sources preferred. Vendor and foundation numbers are self-reported; download counts include CI and transitive installs. Unverified items listed at the end.

claims.claim: Anthropic donated MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), a directed fund under the Linux Foundation, co-founded by Anthropic, Block and OpenAI.
claims.caveat: Donor's announcement.

claims.claim: At the donation, 10,000+ active public MCP servers and 97M+ monthly SDK downloads (Python + TypeScript).
claims.caveat: Vendor-stated; downloads include CI.

claims.claim: At the 2026-07-28 spec release, maintainers said Tier 1 SDKs see close to half a billion downloads a month.
claims.caveat: Project-stated; raw downloads, not users.

claims.claim: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk: 244,574,525 npm downloads, 27 Sep - 26 Oct 2026.
claims.caveat: Includes CI and transitive installs.

claims.claim: Python 'mcp' package: 235,193,557 PyPI downloads last month.
claims.caveat: Includes CI and transitive installs (fastmcp, frameworks).

claims.claim: A third-party snapshot of the official MCP Registry counted 30,375 unique servers from about 18,200 publishers.
claims.caveat: Not verified by us; registry in preview; bulk publishers inflate counts.

claims.claim: Anthropic lists ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and VS Code as MCP adopters.
claims.caveat: Support varies by product and plan; often admin-gated.

claims.claim: MCP support in VS Code became generally available with VS Code 1.102.
claims.caveat: Off by default for Copilot Business/Enterprise until an admin enables it.

claims.claim: 2026-07-28 revision final on 28 July 2026: stateless protocol, no initialize handshake, server/discover, MRTR (input_required) replaces server-initiated requests; sampling, roots and logging deprecated; dynamic client registration deprecated in favour of Client ID Metadata Documents.
claims.caveat: Breaking changes; client and host support lags.

claims.claim: A2A v1.0.0, the first stable specification, tagged 12 March 2026.
claims.caveat: Breaking changes from v0.3.

claims.claim: Linux Foundation: 150+ organisations support A2A (AWS, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow named).
claims.caveat: 'Support' is a stated commitment, not deployment; no production users named.

claims.claim: A2A joined the Agentic AI Foundation, the same foundation as MCP.
claims.caveat: Governance move inside the Linux Foundation.

claims.claim: The A2A project describes A2A and MCP as complementary: A2A connects agents to each other, MCP connects an agent to its tools.
claims.caveat: The project's own positioning.

claims.claim: n8n is fair-code under its Sustainable Use License, self-hostable; not an OSI open-source licence.
claims.caveat: Hosting it as a service needs a commercial licence.

claims.claim: n8n added MCP Client Tool and MCP Server Trigger nodes in release 1.88.0.
claims.caveat: The standalone MCP Client node we used came later.

claims.claim: SAP invested in n8n at a $5.2B valuation; n8n states 1,400+ enterprise customers and 1.7M monthly active builders.
claims.caveat: Company-stated.

claims.claim: MCP generally available in Microsoft Copilot Studio; MCP servers are added as tools over Streamable HTTP.
claims.caveat: Requires generative orchestration.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio connects to MCP servers through Power Platform custom connectors.
claims.caveat: Read from search snippets; connector licensing and DLP policies apply.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio agents can add an external agent over A2A by endpoint URL; the agent card is read from .well-known.
claims.caveat: No preview/GA label on the page.

claims.claim: Salesforce hosted MCP servers generally available for Enterprise Edition and above; they expose org data, flows and Apex to MCP clients under the user's own permissions.
claims.caveat: Page returned 403; details from snippets.

claims.claim: Agentforce's MCP client was in beta in January 2026; admins allowlist tools, partly against tool poisoning.
claims.caveat: Beta; current GA status unverified.

claims.claim: Agentforce Flex Credits: 20 credits ($0.10) per action, packs of 100,000 credits for $500.
claims.caveat: List price May 2025; may have changed.

claims.claim: Prompt injection is LLM01 in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025; Excessive Agency is LLM06.
claims.caveat: Expert consensus, not incident frequency.

claims.claim: Invariant Labs disclosed tool poisoning: hidden instructions in MCP tool descriptions that the model sees and the user does not.
claims.caveat: Proof of concept; vendor sells mitigations.

claims.claim: Invariant Labs showed a malicious public GitHub issue steering an agent using the GitHub MCP server into leaking private-repo data.
claims.caveat: Demo, not an observed breach; architectural (over-broad token + injection).

claims.claim: CVE-2025-6514: OS command injection in mcp-remote 0.0.5-0.1.15 via a crafted OAuth authorization_endpoint; CVSS 9.6.
claims.caveat: Needs connecting to an untrusted server.

claims.claim: The MCP spec's Security Best Practices: confused deputy, token passthrough, scope minimisation; servers MUST NOT accept tokens not issued for them.
claims.caveat: Guidance; not certified.

claims.claim: GitHub's remote MCP server is generally available with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/.
claims.caveat: Some tools need paid licences.

claims.claim: Stack Overflow 2025: 34.4% of agent-using respondents to the agent-tasks question picked 'MCP servers'; 42.8% of those answering the agent data-tools question had used GitHub MCP Server.
claims.caveat: Self-selected; small subgroups of agent users.

claims.claim: Stack Overflow 2025: about 31% used AI agents at work at least monthly; 37.9% had no plans to.
claims.caveat: Mid-2025 data; 31% is a sum of three bands.

unverified: Exact GA day of Salesforce hosted MCP servers and whether the Agentforce MCP client is GA
